title: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
title_zh: TextVBench：评估视频生成中的文本渲染与保留能力

paragraphs.en: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频生成器能够合成逼真的场景，但有时也会错误地渲染某些角色、遗漏所要求的文本，或在不同帧中改变文本内容。 衡量这些失败比单独对每一帧应用 OCR 更为困难：当一个场景包含多个文本目标和多个存在噪声的 OCR 区域时，评估者必须首先确定哪些观察结果对应于哪个预期的文本。 我们提出了 TextVBench——一个基准和评估框架，它将视觉-文本评估构建为一个多目标、多实例的时空对应问题。 TextVBench 包含两个互补的测试轨道：TextVBench-T2V 用于衡量提示所指定文本的生成与保持能力，而 TextVBench-Ref2V 则用于衡量参考图像中文本的保留能力。 这两个轨道均采用目标条件化的候选选择方法，而非无约束的 VLM 转录；支持一个目标对应多个 OCR 区域，并将帧级空间保真度与跨帧时间保真度分离开来。 一种基于长度加权的谐波分数对这些因素进行了综合总结，而额外的文本外诊断则能揭示单一 OCR 分数所掩盖的失败模式。 该基准围绕受控的文本、布局、载体和运动属性进行组织，以便将汇总分数追溯至具体的能力限制。 在所有被评估的模型运行中，MiniMax-H3 的 T2V TextVScore 达到了 68.32，而最强的 Ref2V 分数为 56.51；属性切片显示，随着同时存在的参考文本区域数量增加，分数出现了显著下降。

paragraphs.en: Video generation has advanced from short, unstable clips to visually convincing scenes with coherent subjects, camera motion, and object dynamics. Yet text remains a revealing failure mode. A generated advertisement can look plausible while misspelling a brand, a phone screen can silently replace a number, and a correct word can flicker into a different one for a single frame. Such errors are not minor perceptual artifacts: a one-character change can alter the meaning of the generated content.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成技术已从短暂且不稳定的片段，发展为具有连贯主体、相机运动和物体动态的视觉可信场景。 然而，文本仍然是一个暴露出其失败模式的典型例子。 生成的广告可能看起来合情合理，却拼写错误品牌名称；手机屏幕可能悄无声息地替换某个数字；一个正确的单词也可能在单帧画面中闪烁成另一个词。 这类错误并非轻微的感知性瑕疵：一个字符的改变就可能彻底改变生成内容的含义。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty is not limited to generation. Reliable evaluation itself is non-trivial once a prompt or reference contains several text targets. OCR can split one semantic phrase across multiple boxes, merge adjacent targets, or detect repeated and hallucinated text. Consequently, an evaluator does not receive a ready-made pair of prediction and ground truth. It must first answer a more basic question: which observed region or group of regions corresponds to each intended text target?
paragraphs.zh: 困难并不仅限于生成环节。 一旦提示或参考包含多个文本目标，可靠的评估本身也并非易事。 OCR 可能会将一个语义短语分割到多个框中，合并相邻的目标，或者检测到重复和虚构的文本。 因此，评估者并不会直接获得现成的预测与真实答案配对。 它必须首先回答一个更基础的问题：观察到的哪个区域或区域组对应于每个预期的文本目标？

sents.zh: 困难并不仅限于生成环节。

paragraphs.en: Most image-domain visual-text evaluations avoid this ambiguity through a single word, a short string, or a recoverable reading order [ 21 , 18 , 6 ] . Global string comparison can fail when two correctly rendered targets occupy different semantic regions, while one-to-one set assignment cannot represent a target split across OCR boxes. These are representation failures before they are recognition failures: assignment is only meaningful after observations have been organized into semantic units.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数图像领域的视觉文本评估都通过一个单词、一个短字符串或一个可恢复的阅读顺序来避免这种歧义 [ 21 , 18 , 6 ] 。 当两个正确渲染的目标占据不同的语义区域时，全局字符串比较可能会失败，而一对一集合分配则无法表示跨越多个 OCR 框的目标。 这些是识别失败之前的表示失败：只有在观察结果被组织成语义单元之后，分配才有意义。

paragraphs.en: Video adds a second axis of ambiguity. Text may be temporarily occluded, leave the camera view with its carrier, reappear after a viewpoint change, or become corrupted for only part of a clip. High mean frame accuracy therefore does not imply stable text. More fundamentally, video turns static matching into spatiotemporal state tracking: the target, its carrier, the current visual observation, and its identity over time must remain connected.
paragraphs.zh: 视频引入了第二个模糊性维度。 文本可能会被暂时遮挡，随其载体离开摄像头视野，在视角变化后重新出现，或者仅在片段的一部分中损坏。 因此，高平均帧准确率并不意味着文本稳定。 更根本的是，视频将静态匹配转化为时空状态跟踪：目标、其载体、当前的视觉观察结果以及该目标随时间的身份必须保持关联。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TextVBench to evaluate this structured problem. TextVBench-T2V tests whether a text-to-video model creates prompt-specified text on the intended carrier and maintains it over time. TextVBench-Ref2V tests whether an image-to-video model preserves visual text extracted from one or more reference images. The two tracks share a target-centric evaluator that first obtains OCR candidates, then establishes semantic correspondence using explicit candidate IDs and marker images, and only then computes spatial and temporal fidelity. The vision-language model (VLM), Qwen3.8-27B in our evaluation, selects among OCR candidates; it is not allowed to freely transcribe or repair their text.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入 TextVBench 来评估这一结构化问题。 TextVBench-T2V 用于测试文本到视频模型是否在目标载体上生成提示词指定的文本，并随时间保持该文本的一致性。 TextVBench-Ref2V 用于测试图像到视频模型是否能够保留从一张或多张参考图像中提取的视觉文本。 这两项任务共享一个以目标为中心的评估器：该评估器首先获取 OCR 候选结果，接着利用明确的候选 ID 和标记图像建立语义对应关系，最后才计算空间和时间上的保真度。 在我们的评估中，视觉语言模型（VLM）使用的是 Qwen3.8-27B，它会在多个 OCR 候选结果中进行选择，而不能自由地转录或修改这些文本。

paragraphs.en: We formulate visual-text evaluation in generated video as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem, exposing assumptions that make image-domain OCR scores unreliable in structured scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将生成视频中的视觉-文本评估问题，表述为一个多目标、多实例的时空对应问题，从而揭示了在结构化场景中导致图像域 OCR 分数不可靠的假设。

paragraphs.en: We introduce complementary T2V and Ref2V tracks whose controlled attribute spaces cover text creation and reference preservation under layout, carrier, motion, and viewpoint variation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了互补的 T2V 和 Ref2V 任务分支，其受控属性空间涵盖了在布局、载体、运动和视角变化下的文本生成与参考保留。

paragraphs.en: We develop a target-centric automatic evaluator that supports grouped OCR observations, carrier/reference routing, spatial and temporal fidelity, and auditable diagnostics for per-target missing evidence and extra text from repeated or hallucinated observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种以目标为中心的自动评估器，该评估器支持分组式 OCR 观察、载体/参考路由、空间和时间保真度，以及对每个目标缺失证据和重复或幻觉观察所产生的额外文本进行可审计的诊断分析。

paragraphs.en: Image generation methods increasingly use glyph, layout, or OCR supervision to improve rendered text. GlyphControl and TextDiffuser-2 make this control explicit through glyph-conditioned or language-model-assisted rendering [ 25 , 4 ] . AnyText introduced multilingual generation and editing with an OCR-aware embedding pathway and a dedicated benchmark [ 21 ] ; subsequent benchmarks broadened evaluation toward prompt and text complexity [ 6 ] . TextCrafter introduces CVTG-2K for multiple text instances, lengths, positions, and attributes, and evaluates long-string rendering on LongText-Bench [ 18 ] . These efforts establish that visual text deserves specialized evaluation, but their static setting commonly assumes a simple instance or an order from which a prediction–target alignment can be recovered. TextVBench focuses on the correspondence that precedes scoring when several semantic targets, fragmented OCR observations, carriers, and times are all present.
paragraphs.zh: 图像生成方法越来越多地使用字形、布局或 OCR 监督来改进渲染后的文本。 GlyphControl 和 TextDiffuser-2 通过字形条件化或语言模型辅助的渲染，使这种控制变得明确 [ 25 , 4 ] 。 AnyText 引入了多语言生成与编辑功能，并采用了具备 OCR 感知能力的嵌入路径及专门的基准测试 [ 21 ] ；后续的基准测试则将评估范围扩展到了提示和文本的复杂性上 [ 6 ] 。 TextCrafter 引入了 CVTG-2K，用于处理多个文本实例、长度、位置和属性，并在 LongText-Bench 上评估了长字符串的渲染能力 [ 18 ] 。 这些工作表明视觉文本值得专门的评估，但它们的静态设置通常假设一个简单的实例或一个可以从中恢复预测与目标对齐顺序的序列。 TextVBench 关注的是在多个语义目标、碎片化的 OCR 观测结果、载体和时间同时存在时，评分之前所依赖的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose suites evaluate appearance, prompt alignment, motion, and temporal quality. Reference-free semantic metrics such as CLIPScore show the value of learned image–text alignment, but do not expose character-level omissions or target identity [ 8 ] . VBench decomposes video quality into interpretable dimensions [ 9 ] , VBench++ extends this protocol to broader T2V and I2V settings [ 10 ] , and EvalCrafter combines a wide prompt set with multiple objective metrics and human-aligned aggregation [ 14 ] . AVGen-Bench and MSAVBench broaden evaluation to task-driven audio-video generation and multi-shot narratives, respectively [ 26 , 22 ] . These benchmarks are valuable for overall generative quality, but their visual-text component does not establish target-level spatial assignment or preserve text identity through time.
paragraphs.zh: 通用评估套件会评估外观、提示对齐、动作和时序质量。 无参考语义指标（如 CLIPScore）展示了学习到的图像-文本对齐的价值，但无法揭示字符级的遗漏或目标身份问题 [ 8 ] 。 VBench 将视频质量分解为可解释的维度 [ 9 ] ，VBench++ 将此方法扩展到更广泛的 T2V 和 I2V 场景 [ 10 ] ，而 EvalCrafter 则结合了大量提示集、多种客观指标以及与人类评价对齐的聚合方式 [ 14 ] 。 AVGen-Bench 和 MSAVBench 分别将评估范围扩展到了任务驱动型的音视频生成和多镜头叙事 [ 26 , 22 ] 。 这些基准测试对于评估整体生成质量很有价值，但其视觉-文本组件既无法确定目标级别的空间对应关系，也无法在时间维度上保持文本身份的一致性。

sents.en: General-purpose suites evaluate appearance, prompt alignment, motion, and temporal quality.

sents.zh: 无参考语义指标（如 CLIPScore）展示了学习到的图像-文本对齐的价值，但无法揭示字符级的遗漏或目标身份问题 [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: VBench decomposes video quality into interpretable dimensions [ 9 ] , VBench++ extends this protocol to broader T2V and I2V settings [ 10 ] , and EvalCrafter combines a wide prompt set with multiple objective metrics and human-aligned aggregation [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: VBench 将视频质量分解为可解释的维度 [ 9 ] ，VBench++ 将此方法扩展到更广泛的 T2V 和 I2V 场景 [ 10 ] ，而 EvalCrafter 则结合了大量提示集、多种客观指标以及与人类评价对齐的聚合方式 [ 14 ] 。

sents.en: AVGen-Bench and MSAVBench broaden evaluation to task-driven audio-video generation and multi-shot narratives, respectively [ 26 , 22 ] .
sents.zh: AVGen-Bench 和 MSAVBench 分别将评估范围扩展到了任务驱动型的音视频生成和多镜头叙事 [ 26 , 22 ] 。

sents.en: These benchmarks are valuable for overall generative quality, but their visual-text component does not establish target-level spatial assignment or preserve text identity through time.
sents.zh: 这些基准测试对于评估整体生成质量很有价值，但其视觉-文本组件既无法确定目标级别的空间对应关系，也无法在时间维度上保持文本身份的一致性。

paragraphs.en: T2VTextBench directly demonstrates that contemporary video generators struggle with on-screen text fidelity and temporal consistency, using human evaluation across diverse systems [ 7 ] . Human judgment is flexible and semantically aware, but it is expensive to repeat at training or leaderboard scale. TextVBench complements this direction with an automatic, auditable protocol for multi-target correspondence. Video text spotting systems also model text identity across time rather than recognizing each frame in isolation [ 23 ] ; however, they generally assume transcription of naturally occurring video text, whereas our task must first map generated observations to prompt- or reference-defined targets. TextVBench’s outputs retain the selected OCR candidate IDs and per-target trajectories, enabling both aggregate comparison and inspection of individual decisions.
paragraphs.zh: T2VTextBench 直接证明了当前的视频生成模型在屏幕文本的保真度和时间一致性方面存在困难，这是通过对多种系统进行人类评估得出的 [ 7 ] 。 人类的判断具有灵活性和语义感知能力，但在训练或排行榜规模上重复进行这种评估成本高昂。 TextVBench 通过一种自动且可审计的多目标对应协议，补充了这一研究方向。 视频文本识别系统也会建模文本随时间的身份变化，而不仅仅是孤立地识别每一帧 [ 23 ] ；然而，它们通常假设对自然出现的视频文本进行转录，而我们的任务则必须首先将生成的观察结果映射到由提示或参考定义的目标上。 TextVBench 的输出保留了所选的 OCR 候选 ID 和每个目标的轨迹，从而既支持整体比较，也支持对单个决策的检查。

paragraphs.en: For a single sign containing one requested word, the target and OCR output are naturally paired. Realistic scenes are less convenient. A long target such as FRESH ORANGE JUICE EVERY DAY may span several lines and yield several OCR boxes. Conversely, one OCR box may merge adjacent targets. Comparing each box with one target penalizes a correct rendering because one semantic unit need not equal one detector region.
paragraphs.zh: 对于包含一个请求单词的单个符号，目标与 OCR 输出自然配对。 真实场景则不太方便。 像“FRESH ORANGE JUICE EVERY DAY”这样的长目标可能跨越多行，并产生多个 OCR 框。 相反，一个 OCR 框可能会合并相邻的目标。 将每个框与一个目标进行比较会惩罚正确的渲染结果，因为一个语义单位不一定等于一个检测区域。

paragraphs.en: Consider a prompt that requests B in the upper-left and A in the lower-right. The rendering may satisfy both spatial constraints while a reading-order concatenation returns BA and a target list happens to store AB. A global edit distance then reports an error that the image does not contain. The evaluator must associate content with the specified region or carrier before comparing strings.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个提示要求在左上角放置 B，右下角放置 A。 渲染结果可能同时满足这两个空间约束，但按阅读顺序拼接的结果却是 BA，而目标列表中恰好存储的是 AB。 此时，全局编辑距离会报告一个图像本身并不包含的错误。 评估器在比较字符串之前，必须将内容关联到指定的区域或载体。

paragraphs.en: Modern scene-text detectors expose character- or region-level geometry rather than guaranteed semantic instances [ 2 , 13 ] . Hungarian assignment [ 11 ] improves over concatenation when targets and predictions are already meaningful units. It does not decide which OCR boxes should first be grouped, cannot naturally express a merged box serving several targets, and ignores whether correct text is attached to the wrong carrier. Matching one duplicate also leaves the semantic status of the remaining copies unresolved. The problem is thus not assignment alone, but the representation on which assignment operates.
paragraphs.zh: 现代场景文本检测器暴露的是字符或区域级别的几何信息，而非保证语义一致的具体实例 [ 2 , 13 ] 。 当目标和预测本身已经是具有意义的单元时，匈牙利分配法 [ 11 ] 比拼接法更优。 它无法决定哪些 OCR 框应首先被分组，也无法自然地表达一个合并后的框服务于多个目标，并且忽略了正确文本是否附着在错误的载体上。 匹配一个重复项同样会使其余副本的语义状态悬而未决。 因此，问题并不仅仅在于分配本身，而在于分配所基于的表示方式。

paragraphs.en: A target rendered correctly in most frames but corrupted for a short interval can retain a high frame-average score while visibly flickering. Spatial fidelity asks whether the text is correct at an observation time; temporal fidelity asks whether consecutive observations of the same target remain consistent. Neither quantity substitutes for the other.
paragraphs.zh: 一个目标在大多数帧中都能正确呈现，但在短暂的一段时间内出现损坏，这种情况仍可能保持较高的帧平均得分，同时肉眼可见地闪烁。 空间保真度关注的是在某个观察时刻文本是否正确；时间保真度则关注对同一目标的连续观察结果是否保持一致。 这两个指标都无法替代彼此。

paragraphs.en: Text can disappear because its carrier is occluded or leaves the view, not because the model failed to render it. Viewpoint changes are especially important in Ref2V: text on the front and side of a package is not simultaneously observable. Evaluation therefore needs an explicit activation decision at the carrier or reference level instead of treating every absent OCR result as a miss.
paragraphs.zh: 文本可能消失，是因为其载体被遮挡或离开了视野，而不是因为模型未能将其渲染出来。 在 Ref2V 中，视角变化尤为重要：包装正面和侧面的文本无法同时被观察到。 因此，评估需要在载体或参考层级做出明确的激活决策，而不是将每个缺失的 OCR 结果都视为错误。

paragraphs.en: Repeated strings make tracking ambiguous: if two signs both read SALE and one disappears, string equality alone cannot identify the surviving instance. Carrier ownership, intended position, and reference identity provide the structure needed to maintain a target–observation relation. These cases motivate three design requirements used below: target-centric correspondence, spatial fidelity conditioned on an active carrier/reference, and temporal fidelity over observations of the same target.

paragraphs.en: TextVBench-T2V starts from a text-to-video prompt and a structured set of text slots. It evaluates whether the requested strings are created on their intended carriers and maintained across the generated clip. TextVBench-Ref2V starts from one or more reference images. Runtime reference OCR defines its text slots, and evaluation asks whether those visual-text identities are preserved in the generated video. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , both tracks share OCR perception and target-conditioned correspondence (steps 01–02). The resulting observations support two complementary computations: target-relative spatial fidelity and cross-frame temporal fidelity (steps 03–04), followed by video-level aggregation (step 05). paragraphs.en: T2V examples are built from structured specifications rather than independent free-form prompts. This defines a controlled generation difficulty space in which each specification composes four groups of attributes: (i) text attributes such as language and character/word length; (ii) structural attributes such as target count and slot arrangement; (iii) scene and carrier attributes, including signs, packages, screens, and posters; and (iv) dynamic attributes describing camera, carrier, scale, and viewpoint changes. This construction serves coverage, controllability, and diagnosability: the same fields used to create examples become buckets for the analysis in Sec. 7 .
paragraphs.zh: T2V 示例是基于结构化规范构建的，而非独立的自由格式提示。 这定义了一个受控的生成难度空间，其中每个规范由四组属性组成：(i) 文本属性，如语言和字符/单词长度；(ii) 结构属性，如目标数量和数据槽布局；(iii) 场景和载体属性，包括标识牌、包装、屏幕和海报；以及 (iv) 动态属性，用于描述相机、载体、缩放和视角的变化。 这种构建方式兼顾了覆盖性、可控性和可诊断性：用于创建示例的相同字段也构成了第 7 节分析的分类依据。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , the implemented construction pipeline first filters source scene descriptions for natural visual-text insertion and proposes carrier candidates already compatible with each scene. It then samples feasible easy, medium, and hard variants. The current configuration uses one carrier and one–two slots for easy examples, two carriers and two–three slots for medium examples, and three carriers and three–five slots for hard examples. Text lengths progress from short to medium/long accordingly. A structured scaffold binds every slot to a selected carrier before bilingual English and Chinese strings and parallel prompts are instantiated. Rule and semantic quality control operate on the same specification, so neither language is produced by translating a finished prompt from the other.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，已实现的构建流程首先对源场景描述进行过滤，以实现自然的视觉-文本插入，并提出与每个场景均已兼容的载体候选。 接着，它会采样出可行且难度分别为简单、中等和困难的变体。 当前配置中，简单示例使用一个载体和一至两个槽位，中等示例使用两个载体和两至三个槽位，困难示例则使用三个载体和三至五个槽位。 文本长度也相应地从短到中长依次递增。 在实例化双语的英文与中文字符串及并行提示之前，一个结构化框架会将每个槽位与选定的载体绑定。 规则与语义质量控制均基于同一规范执行，因此两种语言都不是通过从另一种语言翻译已完成提示而生成。

paragraphs.en: Correspondence proceeds in two steps. First, a carrier-consistency judge decides whether each required carrier is present and which candidate IDs belong to it. This acts as a hard spatial boundary: text copied into a subtitle cannot satisfy a target assigned to a poster. Second, candidates within the carrier are associated with targets. A programmatic fast path accepts the highest-similarity candidate when it reaches the configured threshold; unresolved targets are sent in small batches to a VLM together with the marker image and compact candidate list. The VLM returns only selected IDs. It may select several IDs in visual reading order for a fragmented target, but may not freely OCR, translate, or correct candidate strings. Candidate IDs consumed by one request batch are removed before the next, while reuse inside a batch permits a single merged OCR region to support adjacent targets. Figure 2 (step 02) illustrates one target selecting two ordered OCR regions before scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 通信流程分为两个步骤。 首先，载体一致性判定器会判断每个必需的载体是否存在，以及哪些候选 ID 属于该载体。 这构成了一个严格的空间边界：复制到字幕中的文本无法满足分配给海报的目标。 其次，载体内的候选项会与目标进行关联。 程序化的快速路径会在相似度达到设定阈值时接受相似度最高的候选项；未解决的目标则会与小批量数据一同，连同标记图像和精简的候选项列表一起发送给 VLM。 VLM 仅返回选定的 ID。 对于碎片化的目标，它可能会按照视觉阅读顺序选择多个 ID，但无法自由地对候选字符串进行 OCR、翻译或修正。 一个请求批次中使用的候选项 ID 会在下一批次前被移除，但在同一批次内可以重复使用，从而允许单个合并的 OCR 区域支持相邻的目标。 图 2（步骤 02）展示了一个目标在评分前选择两个有序 OCR 区域的示例。

paragraphs.en: Ref2V measures preservation rather than creation. Each example contains a generation instruction and one or more reference images drawn from diverse text-bearing carriers, including product packaging, mobile interfaces such as the AMEX GUI dataset [ 3 ] , and synthetic application screens. paragraphs.en: For a single-reference sample, that reference is activated directly. For a multi-reference sample, a VLM first routes each generated frame to zero, one, or several reference IDs using compact reference images labeled with explicit IDs. Only slots from active references enter target–candidate matching. A frame with no active reference is recorded but excluded from fidelity and extra-text aggregation; if no sampled frame activates any reference, all fidelity scores are zero. Active slots are then matched to generated-frame OCR candidates using the same marker-image candidate-selection protocol as T2V. Single-reference samples still use this generated-frame marker image; they skip only the unnecessary reference-ID routing call. Reference images provide grounding, but all scored text still comes from OCR candidates. The reference routing and visibility-aware target trajectories are illustrated in Fig. 2 (steps 02 and 04).

paragraphs.en: Ref2V uses Eqs. 3 – 7 at slot level. Within each reference, spatial and temporal scores are weighted by target length; reference-level scores are then averaged equally so that a reference with no successful observations cannot disappear from the denominator. ExtraTextRatio is averaged only over evaluated frames.

paragraphs.en: Temporal fidelity is computed only across observations for which the target’s reference is active. A single-reference clip keeps its sole reference active because construction requires that carrier to remain observable; an absent match is therefore a preservation failure under the requested generation condition. In multi-reference samples, intervals routed to no reference are excluded, and matching resumes under the same slot and reference identities when a reference reappears. This separates expected observability from true missing text without requiring all reference views in every frame.

paragraphs.en: On T2V, pooled TextVScore drops from 38.29 on easy cases to 16.86 on hard cases, a 21.43-point decrease; Spatial and Temporal drop by 0.207 and 0.216. ExtraTextRatio also rises from 0.190 to 0.215. The model-level degradation varies substantially: the hard–easy TextVScore gap is 44.01 points for Wan2.2 T2V-A14B but 15.56 points for MiniMax-H3, indicating that the construction levels expose different robustness profiles. paragraphs.en: The evaluator depends on OCR and target–candidate correspondence. Tiny or stylized text, severe blur or perspective, dense layouts, and repeated strings can therefore confound generation errors with perception or matching errors; Ref2V also inherits errors from OCR on the reference image. The protocol further assumes persistent target strings and bounded frame sampling. Dynamic or state-changing text remains outside the fixed benchmark; multi-reference Ref2V can handle reference-level inactivity and reappearance, whereas instance-level T2V re-entry after leaving the view is not modeled by the current protocol. The reported scores should be interpreted within these assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器依赖于 OCR 以及目标与候选的对应关系。 因此，微小或风格化的文本、严重的模糊或透视效果、密集布局以及重复字符串可能会将生成错误与感知或匹配错误混淆；Ref2V 也会继承参考图像中 OCR 的错误。 该协议进一步假设目标字符串是持久的，并且帧采样是有限的。 动态或状态变化的文本仍属于固定基准之外；多参考的 Ref2V 能够处理参考级别的静态存在与重新出现，而当前协议并未对实例级别的 T2V 在离开视野后的重新进入进行建模。 所报告的分数应在此类假设框架内进行解读。

paragraphs.en: Visual-text evaluation cannot be reduced to OCR accuracy because OCR outputs must first be associated with intended semantic targets. Video makes this association temporal: text identity must remain connected to a carrier or reference while observations change across frames. TextVBench makes this correspondence explicit through complementary T2V creation-and-maintenance and Ref2V preservation-and-maintenance tracks, followed by target-centric spatial and temporal scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉文本评估不能简化为 OCR 准确率，因为 OCR 的输出必须首先与预期的语义目标建立关联。 视频使这种关联具有时间维度：文本身份必须始终与载体或参考保持连接，而观察结果则会在不同帧中发生变化。 TextVBench 通过互补的 T2V 创建与维护以及 Ref2V 保留与维护流程明确这种对应关系，随后进行以目标为中心的空间和时间评分。

paragraphs.en: The structured outputs are useful beyond a leaderboard. Candidate-level matches and per-target trajectories can support data curation, hard-example mining, reward modeling, and generate–verify–repair systems. TextVBench-Challenge extends this direction toward collecting reproducible failures beyond the current evaluation assumptions (Sec. 8 ). We hope TextVBench helps shift visual-text evaluation from frame-wise transcription toward structured spatiotemporal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化输出的价值不仅限于排行榜。 候选级匹配和每个目标的轨迹可用于支持数据整理、困难样本挖掘、奖励建模以及生成–验证–修复系统。 TextVBench-Challenge 将这一方向延伸至收集可复现的失败案例，突破了当前评估假设的局限（第 8 节）。 我们希望 TextVBench 能帮助视觉文本评估从逐帧转录转向结构化的时空推理。
